messages:
emma: hi all, new hire here (emma). trying to finish cloud setup. two issues: 1) can't create a GCP service account key for project redwood-eu-data (permission denied), 2) when I try `aws sts assume-role` into acct 210987654321 it errors with \"Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole\". also i need kms/decrypt on a customer key in prod-eu for a demo. who do I bug?
ryan: welcome emma! quick: for gcp SA keys you need iam.serviceAccountKeys.create and the serviceAccountAdmin role on the SA. which SA are you hitting?
emma: trying to create key for sa:training-runner@redwood-eu-data.iam.gserviceaccount.com. gcloud command returns: 
```
 gcloud iam service-accounts keys create key.json --iam-account=training-runner@redwood-eu-data.iam.gserviceaccount.com
 ERROR: (gcloud.iam.service-accounts.keys.create) PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission iam.serviceAccountKeys.create denied on resource
```
lina: that's because we disabled user-managed keys in EU for prod projects. policy is to use workload identity or KMS-wrapped keys. Is this a short-term dev key or prod workflow?
emma: dev demo only, but needs access to decrypt small sample model weights stored in GCS encrypted with a customer-managed key.
ryan: ok -- two routes: (A) create a short-lived bound SA key via ops with justification, (B) use Workload Identity Federation from your local env -> impersonate SA, or (C) grant you kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt via a grant so you don't need SA key. Which do you prefer?
emma: (C) sounds safest. how do i request that?
ops-bot: new request created: CR-3122 (kms grant) by emma. Please provide key resource name and justification.
emma: key: projects/redwood-eu/locations/global/keyRings/prod-eu/cryptoKeys/model-weights. justification: onboarding demo for model verification, read-only, <24h access.
lina: tagging infra: i'll add a grant entry and set expiration 24h. Ryan, can you confirm there are no production restrictions that block granting to a new hire?
ryan: fine by infra if scoped to a single principal and 24h TTL. we'll create a grant for principle: user:emma@redwood.dev and log it. ops-bot will record.
emma: thanks! next question: AWS assume-role error — i know my okta assertion shows the role arn but AWS returns AccessDenied.
lina: common issue is missing role trust for the SAML provider or role session name length. Can you paste the exact CLI error?
emma: `An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRoleWithSAML operation: Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithSAML`
ryan: That suggests Okta sent the assertion but AWS didn't map the attribute correctly. @lina can you check the Okta app mapping for account 210987654321/Redwood-Dev-Role? Also confirm emma is in okta group devs-eu.
lina: you're not in devs-eu. probably created only in core devs. added emma@redwood.dev to group and re-synced SAML. try again?
emma: trying now... still same error.
ryan: hm. checking the role trust policy... it lists SAML provider arn:aws:iam::210987654321:saml-provider/okta-redwood with Condition: StringEquals SAML:audience = https://signin.amazonaws.com/saml. Okta is sending audience fine. Could be missing the AttributeStatement mapping for https://aws.amazon.com/SAML/Attributes/Role. Lina, did the app push the Role attribute?
lina: fixed mapping and pushed. ops-bot: updated mapping for okta-app aws-prod to include Role attribute. emma, test again.
emma: success! can assume role arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/Redwood-Dev-Role — thanks :white_check_mark:
finance: finance note: if you spin GPUs or prod storage during demo, tag with cost_center=onboarding and ping me to set a spend alert.
emma: will do. one last thing: quota in eu-west-1 for GPUs is low for my demo. how to request short-term bump?
ryan: file cloud-requests with region=eu-west-1, resource=A100, qty=2, duration=48h, link to CR-3122 for audit. I'll escalate to provider support.
emma: filed request CR-3123. ops-bot: linked CR-3123 -> CR-3122. thanks everyone, this unblocks demo.
ryan: welcome aboard emma — ping here if anything else breaks and add yourself to docs/onboarding/cloud-access.md for notes on SA keys and okta groups.
